report:
The central all-reference construction reconstructs successfully; I found no concrete mathematical defect in it. The full requested audit remains incomplete because completionCriteria explicitly requires inspection of the controlling book’s positive-growth dichotomy. Its proposition and proof body are not supplied here, and searches did not locate an accessible primary source. The statement that this proof was previously read cannot establish its hypotheses, conclusion, or applicability. Consequently the claimed strengthening of that book result remains unverified.

I checked Lemmas 1–5 independently. Finite generation, elimination, closedness, and the nearest-point separation argument establish the stated support alternative. Lemma 3 correctly derives germ supports using rational endpoints and arbitrary real weights, then proves the inequalities for PCCs on other structures by following carrier-contained segments. Lemma 4 uses balancing and agreement of the support form with the tangential slope to establish effectivity for every positive cycle dimension on ordinary opens, including real weights. The active-face rational box in Lemma 5 gives an exact convex decomposition while preserving every strict recession inequality; it does not merely approximate the reference.

All six original plane lattices are saturated: their plane equations are respectively z=0, y=0, y=z, x=0, x=z, and x=y. Every triple of distinct generators has determinant ±1. The original-ray quotient normals and diagonal normals are primitive. The recursive algebra’s plane-index factors, tangential cancellation, balancing, commutativity, refinement compatibility, and codimension-two quotient argument are valid. The normalization is recursive intersection without division by 2!. In particular, the original-ray tangential correction for q is −1, producing weight 2, and the complete calculation gives q²·[X]=8δ₀.

The gluing inequalities establish a common positive rational growth bound. Taking maxima only between rational component functions gives rational comparison walls; the exact original real weights restore P=γ outside the specified compact set. P≥γ and the roof construction make the obstacle nonnegative and compactly supported. The raw-envelope proof bounds every competitor using rational PCC endpoints, then handles arbitrary real centres by an enclosing rational simplex. It assumes no continuity of those competitors. The sequence P+1/n directly establishes this PA envelope’s membership in the declared real regularizable class; its operator value is already defined by the reconstructed PA intersection algebra.

The complete contact calculation is sound: locality gives 8λ²δ₀ on ρ<2R, while the integrand −εb_R vanishes on ρ≥R. Thus roof-boundary, interpolation, lower-face, and exterior atoms contribute zero, yielding exactly −8ελ². The choice ε∈{1,2} also establishes the claimed nonseparability.

I independently checked the explicit example’s comparison covectors, all 22 first-divisor edges, primitive outgoing directions, and balancing at all nine vertices. The masses are 1/2 at zero, 27/8 at each A₁,A₂,A₃, 11/8 at A₄, 1 at D₊, 5 at D₋, and 3 at each D₁₄,D₂₄. Their sum is 24 and the complete contact integral is −1/2. Exact-arithmetic checks corroborate these finite calculations; they are not verification of the universal theorem or of the claimed build artifacts.

I opened the specified [BMPS v1 PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.08664v1), including Example 6.24 and the complete Claim 6.25 proof. Its carrier identification, reference values, envelope equality, mass four, and failure of positive recession growth agree with the comparison. This independently reconstructed witness therefore goes beyond merely identifying the known carrier failure. Definition 6.19 is expressly one-dimensional; the draft appropriately makes neither a higher-dimensional smoothness claim nor a PAPC+ claim.

Harmless citation correction: saturated tangent lattices are defined in BMPS Definition 2.1; Definitions 2.18–2.20 supply normals, weights, and balancing. No substantial repair was applied. The original classification remains open, as stated. The main proof has no indispensable external theorem premise; the expressly declared comparison notes are excluded from premises. Supplying the authentic Chapter 72 proposition and full proof is necessary to complete the remaining mandatory comparison.
